title: How Much of What Remains Is Asked For on a Snowsports School Product Sold with Instalments
content:
A Snowsports School product offered with scheduled instalments does not ask the household for the whole of what remains in one go.

The sessions still to come are counted as the sessions the block holds less the delivery entries standing on the account.

Where the product is offered with scheduled instalments and the booking still holds three or more sessions to come, the first instalment share of 50 percent of what remains is collected. Where the product is offered with scheduled instalments and the booking holds one or two sessions to come, the final instalment share of 80 percent of what remains is collected. Where the product is not offered with scheduled instalments, or the booking holds no session still to come, the whole share of 100 percent of what remains is collected.

## Which products are offered with scheduled instalments

| Product | Scheduled instalments offered |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | no |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | no |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | no |
| Six-Week Development Programme | yes |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | no |
| Private Instruction Full Day | no |
| Elite Performance Camp | yes |

## Instalments offered and sessions to come

| Product offered with instalments | Sessions still to come | Share of what remains collected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 3 or more | 50 percent |
| yes | exactly 3 | 50 percent |
| yes | 2 | 80 percent |
| yes | 1 | 80 percent |
| yes | none | 100 percent |
| no | any number | 100 percent |

## A reading on hypothetical figures

Take 600.00 USD remaining on a booking of the Six-Week Development Programme, whose block holds 6 sessions. Where 2 delivery entries stand on the account, 4 sessions are still to come, and 50 percent of what remains, 300.00 USD, is collected. Where 5 delivery entries stand, 1 session is still to come, and 80 percent of what remains, 480.00 USD, is collected. Where all 6 delivery entries stand, no session is still to come and the whole 600.00 USD is collected.

Take instead 600.00 USD remaining on a booking of the Private Instruction Full Day, which is not offered with scheduled instalments: the whole 600.00 USD is collected whatever the sessions still to come.
